context: Tests whether the agent correctly creates a sensei profile in the right location with the required structure, including all mandatory sections, a stop condition, and a concise scope statement. The profile should be placed in `profiles/` with a lowercase filename.

checklist.name: Correct directory
checklist.description: Profile file is written inside a `profiles/` directory (e.g., `profiles/docs.md` or `profiles/documentation.md`)

checklist.name: Lowercase filename
checklist.description: Profile filename is lowercase (e.g., `docs.md`, not `Docs.md` or `Documentation.md`)

checklist.name: # Name Agent heading
checklist.description: Profile starts with a `# <Name> Agent` heading (e.g., `# Docs Agent` or `# Documentation Agent`)

checklist.name: One-line role description
checklist.description: A single line immediately below the heading describes the agent's domain and boundary

checklist.name: Design Intent section
checklist.description: Profile contains a `## Design Intent` section

checklist.name: Stop condition present
checklist.description: The Scope section explicitly states when the agent should stop and hand off (e.g., 'If X, stop and hand off' or 'When Y, escalate')

checklist.name: Scope as boundary
checklist.description: The Scope section lists specific directories/files that are in-bounds AND explicitly states what is out of bounds — it does NOT read as a task checklist

checklist.name: Under 40 lines
checklist.description: The profile markdown file has 40 or fewer lines total
